senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; קער to be sunk, dish, charger.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:17">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אלכסנדרוס … ואת הים כק׳</he> when Alexander the Macedonian attempted to ascend to heaven, he rose higher and higher, until he saw the earth beneath him like a ball and the sea like a dish; <he>ויצורינה ק׳ בידיה</he> and why is he not represented with a dish in his hand?; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Num. R. s. 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הקריב ק׳ … ודומה לק׳</he> he offered a charger which is typical of the sea that surrounds the whole world and resembles a dish.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:11">B. Bath. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בקש איוב להפוך ק׳ על פיה</he> Job attempted to turn the dish upside down, i.e. to challenge Providence; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְעָרוֹת</he>.
